topic: seo myths from google's own guide: meta keywords, word count, keyword domain
hook: Your meta keywords tag? Google ignores it. Completely.
caption:
Comment LEARN and I'll send you my free SEO starter guide. Follow for one SEO and web design lesson a day.

3 SEO myths. All busted by Google's own SEO Starter Guide.

Google Search doesn't use the meta keywords tag. Gone. There's no magic word count either, so a 3,000 word page about gutters in Denver doesn't win just for being long. And stuffing "bestroofer" into your domain name does almost nothing for you on Google.

Spend those 2 hours on a page that answers what customers ask you on the phone.

#seo #webdesign #seotips #websitetips #seoforbeginners
